title: Rename Table
description: Learn how to rename a table using sp_rename or SQL Server Management Studio.

data.text: SQL Server does not have a direct statement to rename a table. Instead, use the sp_rename stored procedure or SQL Server Management Studio.

data.title: sp_rename Syntax
data.content: Renames a table from old name to new name.

data.text: Both the old and new table names must be enclosed in single quotation marks.
The following example renames the sales.contr table to contracts.

data.title: Rename Table with sp_rename
data.content: Creates the contr table and renames it to contracts.

data.text: SQL Server returns a caution message: Changing any part of an object name could break scripts and stored procedures.

data.title: Caution
data.text: Renaming a table can break existing scripts, stored procedures, and views that reference the old name. Update all references manually after renaming.
You can also rename a table using SQL Server Management Studio:

items: Right-click the table name and choose Rename
Type the new name and press Enter

data.alt: SQL Server rename table using SSMS step 1

data.title: Rename Table Key Points
points: Use sp_rename to rename a table via T-SQL.
Both old and new names must be in single quotes.
SSMS provides a graphical way to rename tables.
Always update references in scripts, stored procedures, and views after renaming.
